Card Q&A.q: Can I place either my Digimon or an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card for this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Ice-Snow] trait Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost. For each of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards, add 1 to this effect's level maximum.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 Digimon with no digivolution cards as the bottom security card, this Digimon unsuspends.
